title: Jon Pardi and Wife Summer Divorcing After 5 Years of Marriage
summary: "We are committed to moving forward with love and respect as co-parents," they wrote in a statement.
contentText:
Jon Pardi and Summer Pardi have announced they are splitting.

On Friday (July 3), the 41-year-old country singer and his wife, 37, shared a joint statement on social media revealing that they are divorcing after five years of marriage.

The pair, who wed in November 2020 , are parents to daughters Presley Fawn, 3, and Sienna Grace, 2.

“After much thought, we have made the difficult decision to end our marriage,” they wrote on Instagram post. “Our daughters will always remain our highest priority and we are committed to moving forward with love and respect as co-parents.”

The pair added, “Thank you so much for your understanding, support, and respect as we navigate these changes as a family.”

Shortly after posting the news, the “Dirt on My Boots” singer shared another message on his Instagram Stories .

“While I navigate this next chapter, I’m going to take some time away from social media to focus on myself and my family,” he wrote. “Thanks to you all for the love and support. My team will handle posting for the time being. I’ll see you at the shows.”

The former couple’s split comes as Pardi is in the midst of his Honkytonk Hollywood tour, which is scheduled to conclude Dec. 11 at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas. The trek is in support of his most recent album of the same title.

Jon and Summer met in May 2017 after being set up on a blind date by one of Summer’s clients and a friend of Jon’s mother.

“Within the first five minutes of meeting Jon, it was game over for me,” the hairstylist previously told People . “I texted my mom, ‘Sell my house, sell my car, send my dog.’”

The former couple got engaged during Pardi’s concert at Nashville’s historic Ryman Auditorium in October 2019.
